name: Sukina Yatsu kara Ren'ai Soudan sareta
original_name: 好きなヤツから恋愛相談された
source:
University student Sakuraba Ryo is in love with his classmate Shinomiya Kazuki.
But one day, Kazuki tells him, "There's someone I'm interested in," and ask him for love advice...?!


[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13453]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
大学生樱庭亮爱上了他的同学四宫和树。
但有一天，一树对他说“我有喜欢的人”，并向他寻求爱情建议……？！


[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13453]Novelgame[/url]]
